content:
Marta G.: Hey @channel — ACME (tenant acme-corp-prod) reports their promo voucher 7f4a23b9 landed on Private (private-v1) instead of the intended Dedicated SKU (dedicated-standard). Dedicated provision is blocked with billing_mismatch. Can billing/infra help?

support-bot: New support ticket created: S-4832.

Luis R.: pinging @Sara (Billing) and @Kevin - Infra. Marta, can you paste the tenant id + voucher id and the error from the provision job?

Marta G.: Tenant: acme-corp-prod
Voucher: 7f4a23b9
Intended SKU: dedicated-standard
Applied to: private-v1
Provision log: `Provision failed: container_create: billing_mismatch: voucher target=dedicated-standard, bound_to=private-v1`

Sara (Billing): Looking. Voucher metadata shows target_sku=dedicated-standard but allocated_to=private-v1. We can reassign but need finance approval for forced rebind. @Kevin - any infra caveats?

Kevin - Infra: Note private-v1 uses A100 profiles, dedicated-standard uses H100. If we simply change DB allocation, the provisioner will try to create H100-backed nodes. Also dedicated-standard pool is currently at ~92% commit. If we force-bind we risk overcommit. Need capacity check.

Luis R.: Quick repro I ran in staging: 1) GET /admin/v1/tenants/acme-corp-prod/vouchers -> shows allocated_to=private-v1 2) POST /admin/v1/vouchers/transfer {voucher: "7f4a23b9", to: "dedicated-standard"} -> 403 "cannot transfer: bound to private"

Marta G.: Customer confirmed they approve us moving it, they need guaranteed SLA on dedicated.

Sara (Billing): Finance approved for this one-time migration given SLA requirement. Plan: (1) Pause new voucher consumption on private-v1 (2) DB update allocated_to->"dedicated-standard" and set allocation_time=now (3) Invalidate billing cache + re-eval quotas (4) Trigger provision job for tenant.

Kevin - Infra: Before step 2 I will reserve capacity in dedicated-standard to avoid overcommit. If dedicated-standard can't expand, fallback is dedicated-burst which the customer already rejected. Confirming reserved slot now.

Marta G.: Customer: "We require dedicated-standard, cannot accept burst."

Sara (Billing): Running migration command from admin box: `./admin-tool voucher-migrate --voucher 7f4a23b9 --from private-v1 --to dedicated-standard --force --note "S-4832 ACME SLA"`

support-bot: Audit trail: voucher migration initiated by Sara (Billing) at 2026-03-16T15:12:34Z (trace=01ABCDXYZ).

Kevin - Infra: Reserved capacity applied and DB change reflected. Triggering provision: `POST /internal/provision?tenant=acme-corp-prod&sku=dedicated-standard`

Elaine Ops: Provision returned 200. Instance r-9f8a (h100-2) created and attached to tenant. Health-checks passing.

Marta G.: Customer confirms instance is up and responding to traffic. They reported latency within SLA. :tada:

Luis R.: Closing S-4832 on my side. Follow-up: I'll open an internal ticket to scan for vouchers whose target_sku != allocated_to and add a guard to voucher issuance.

Sara (Billing): Adding action: add a validation to allocation service to reject issuing dedicated-targeted vouchers that default to private profile, and add an alert if allocation mapping is inconsistent.

Kevin - Infra: Suggest also alerting when committed capacity for a SKU >90% so we can surface capacity constraints pre-issuance.

Marta G.: Thanks everyone. Documenting steps in ticket and sending customer summary.

support-bot: S-4832 status -> Resolved. Audit complete.
